## Rationale

`{statim}` is designed for extrapolation of estimation methods in statistical inference, attempting to bring barely known methods into `{statim}` pipelines, while harnessing syntactic sugars when writing `{statim}` syntax. `stat_define` is another but the main data structure of `{statim}` that keeps the implementation and the rest of the metadata which describes the pipeline. 

## Anatomy of stat_define

This is the containerization of the existing methods while being called in a single line. We have:

1.  `model_type` - you must supply a [`<model_id>`](https://s7-stats.github.io/statim/articles/pointers/model_id.html) that 

2.  `impl` - a list of methods to be used in a single `<stat_fn>`

3.  `compatible_params`

4.  `claim_translator`
